fact: A letter from the ministry's acting secretary general opening the annual school census for 2025-2026 (first phase 20 October to 7 November 2025, covering primary and secondary schooling) states that the updating of the data in the MASSAR system is the main reference from which most of the statistical data come.
title: Le ministère de l'Éducation nationale lance le recensement scolaire annuel pour l'année scolaire 2025-2026
